senses.gloss:
ni (IE 8-1; EI 33), abbreviation of nibaddha or nirīkṣita, i. e. registered or approved.
 (Select Inscriptions, pp. 238-39, 247-48), explained as an abbreviation of nija and as a sort of genitive suffix often with a word indicating relationship understood.

nī (LP), used for the verb ānī.
 (LP), to make.
